name: Museum of Folk Culture
nameVi: Bảo tàng Văn hóa Dân gian
kicker: Folk culture in a house through to the river
summary: A 57-metre merchant house at 33 Nguyễn Thái Học that runs through to Bạch Đằng on the river. Upstairs, 490 objects cover folk art, performance, traditional trades, and daily life; downstairs, the same crafts are demonstrated. Give it a museum hour. The house itself is half the visit.
fee: 20,000 VND from 10 Aug 2026, or a combination ticket
heroCaption: The wooden front of the Museum of Folk Culture

notice.title: Closed on the 20th of each month
notice.body: The museum opens every day except the 20th of the month. Plan around that date.

body: The museum is the old house at 33 Nguyễn Thái Học, 57 metres long and 9 metres wide, two floors with a wooden upper storey, opening onto both Nguyễn Thái Học and Bạch Đằng. It opened to visitors on 24 March 2005.

Upstairs, 490 objects cover four themes: folk visual art, folk performance, traditional trades, and daily life. Downstairs, the same crafts are demonstrated. Oil lamps, tools, and the performances are the visit; the house is the container.
It is open every day except the 20th of the month. Entry is part of the old-town ticket.

figures.caption: Oil lamps in a case
figures.alt: A row of metal and glass oil lamps in the Museum of Folk Culture in Hoi An

gettingThere: Walk to 33 Nguyễn Thái Học, the street closer to the river than Trần Phú. The house also opens onto Bạch Đằng.

legs.heading: From the old town
legs.body: Walk to 33 Nguyễn Thái Học, the street closer to the river than Trần Phú.

closed: Closed on the 20th of each month.
admissionNote: No separate price for this building. From 10 Aug 2026: 20,000 VND per person per building, the same for every visitor (Da Nang Resolution 98/2026). Heritage centre notices of 26 Jan and 16 Mar 2026: 80,000 VND (streetscape, Chùa Cầu or Miếu Quan Công, and two other works) or 120,000 VND (adds a museum and three other works), usable through a stay of up to three days. A May 2026 article counts those as four and six works. Ask at the booth which ticket is on sale.
